selected.modifications: Replace generated Forest/Squire decks and hidden P1 defaults with both pinned 40-card green decks, explicit library order and both keep declarations. Preserve seven/33 cardinalities. Add named initial and post-keep checkpoints.
selected.independent_basis: CR 103.4, 103.5; 20 life, seven initial cards, no free mulligan in two-player non-Brawl play. Redraw seven and bottom for each mulligan before the next declaration round.
selected.combat_audit: Not a combat case. No damage assignment ordering, trample or deathtouch semantics present.
selected.upstream_vintage: No rules revision declared by source; reconciled against pinned CR 103.5.

selected.modifications: Replace generated cards/UUIDs and stream-first selection with explicit card identities and bottom choice. Inject the entire 40-card replacement shuffle. Script both seats in declaration order. Preserve seven/33 redraw and six/34 after bottoming. No free mulligan.
selected.independent_basis: CR 103.4, 103.5; 20 life, seven initial cards, no free mulligan in two-player non-Brawl play. Redraw seven and bottom for each mulligan before the next declaration round.
selected.combat_audit: Not a combat case. No damage assignment ordering, trample or deathtouch semantics present.
selected.upstream_vintage: No rules revision declared by source; reconciled against pinned CR 103.5.

not_selected.reason: Thorn Elemental and as-though-unblocked ability outside pool; AI case also violates explicit choices. Harness example only, never v0 coverage.
not_selected.combat_audit: CR 510.1c/d now permit dividing damage among blockers without an assignment order. These single-blocker tests cannot establish current multiple-blocker semantics. Do not replace Thorn Elemental ability with trample: CR 702.19 has lethal-assignment requirements, and CR 702.2 modifies lethal for deathtouch. Any future combat adaptation must script assignments directly, never order blockers then respond.

not_selected.reason: Choice-cardinality harness examples only; arbitrary resolution-time target selection is not an advertised pool capability. Bite Down targets are selected while casting (601.2c), revalidated at resolution (608.2b).
not_selected.combat_audit: No combat declarations or damage; no inherited assignment order.

distribution_review: Only original selection/audit metadata and retained MIT notice; no upstream Java tests or card/rules text copied. Future adaptations retain these sources, full MIT notice and all file notices. Original GH-15 fixtures were authored from rules, not translations of these candidates.
reference_caveat: An adaptation executed by XMage is not independent corroboration by XMage. Selection and schema validation count neither as adaptation nor execution.
